sourceText:
Southern Squash Fritters
By: Alyce
Published: Friday, February 26, 2010 - 5:25am

Ingredients




2 cups grated raw yellow squash
1 small onion, grated (more or less to taste)
1/2 teaspoon pepper
1 tablespoon sugar
6 tablespoons self-rising flour or biscuit mix
2 eggs, slightly beaten
2 teaspoons butter, melted
Oil for frying

Preparation

1 Mix together squash, onion, pepper and sugar. 2 Add flour and eggs. 3 Mix only until squash is coated. 4 Stir in butter. 5 Heat oil in pan, just enough to coat well. 6 Drop batter by tablespoons into hot pan. 7 Cook until golden brown and turn once (or more if needed).

About


Needing a different idea for what to do with all the fresh squash you're getting this summer? This is a simple recipe that some call squash fritters and some call it squash cakes. Whatever you want to call it, give it a try. This recipe makes a lot (6 servings), so you might want to cut the recipe in half the first time.
